lastCompletedStory.title: Add the backend-aware model resolution layer with fail-closed codex and claude paths

nextStoryContext: src/config/model-resolution.ts now exports resolvePhaseModel({ phase, backend, configPath?, cacheReader? }) -> { ok: true; model } | { ok: false; message }, composed entirely on top of pre-existing modules (readPhaseModel from models.ts, validateClaudeModel from claude-models.ts, isClaudeAliasModel from supervisor/codex-auth.ts, readCodexModelsCache from codex-models-cache.ts). src/config/models.ts is byte-for-byte untouched (pinned by a git-diff oracle). Codex precedence: nested [models.codex].<phase> pin (verbatim, no shape check) > non-claude-shaped flat [models].<phase> value (verbatim) > cacheReader() auto-resolution (default readCodexModelsCache) > fail-closed ok:false naming '~/.codex/models_cache.json' and the '[models.codex]' pin remedy. The nested-vs-flat discriminator is two readPhaseModel calls (with and without the backend arg) compared for inequality -- cheapest available, no new parse path. Claude precedence: flat/default value validated with the STRICT validateClaudeModel typo-guard, returned verbatim on ok, else ok:false naming the offending value and the 'project.toml [models].<phase>' key; the codex cache reader is never invoked on this path. Nothing in the codebase calls resolvePhaseModel yet -- it was built and tested in isolation, same 'reader-first, wiring-later' shape as US-002's readCodexModelsCache. The 6 existing readPhaseModel call sites (run.ts, loop.ts, review.ts, plan-runner.ts x2, config.ts) are UNCHANGED and still call readPhaseModel directly; a future story would need to decide whether/how to route those call sites through resolvePhaseModel (and whether the resulting ok:false abort composes with or supersedes the existing codexAuthPreflight claude-alias-model early-reject at each of those 4 dispatch sites, since the two checks currently overlap in the 'claude alias handed to codex' case).

officialDocsValidated.summary: This story composes existing internal modules (models.ts, claude-models.ts, codex-auth.ts, codex-models-cache.ts) with no new external library or documented API surface; US-001/US-002's Step 5.5 fetches (Claude Code model-config docs, openai/codex protocol source) already cover the vocabulary this module reuses.
